verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no user-configurable alerting, meaning no rules that fire on specific conditions such as error rates or metric thresholds and notify by chat or email. What it does show is adjacent: observability monitoring and custom metrics without alerts, webhooks as a developer building block, and a Marketplace Slack integration that posts fixed event messages such as deployment status. None of these is condition-based alerting by the product itself.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can set up alerts that notify me via chat or email when specific conditions are met
